title: Japan Autumn Getaway: Nikko and Karuizawa
alt: Autumn maples around the Shinkyo bridge at Nikko, Japan
transport: Private transfers, trains and guided touring

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Well placed hotel in Shinjuku, minutes from the station

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: A first night in Shinjuku with the evening free, before the trip heads north into the hills.

stops.name: Nikko
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Quiet hotel in the hills outside Nikko

activities.name: Nikko heritage and scenic highlights
activities.description: Rinno-ji temple and the Shoyoen garden, then the lacquered Toshogu shrine in its cedar forest and the Shinkyo bridge.

program.name: Nikko
program.description: A night in the hills at Nikko, with its shrines, gardens and the red Shinkyo bridge over the river.

stops.name: Karuizawa
stops.subtitle: Karuizawa to Yudanaka and Matsumoto
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel beside Karuizawa station in the highlands

activities.name: Shorinzan Daruma temple
activities.description: The temple at Takasaki where the round daruma dolls come from, thousands of them left behind as wishes fulfilled.

activities.name: The Stone Church at Karuizawa
activities.description: A chapel of stone arches and glass built into the hillside, one of the quietest pieces of architecture in the country.

activities.name: Jigokudani monkey park
activities.description: The hot spring at Yudanaka where wild macaques sit chest deep in the steaming water, often with snow on their heads.

activities.name: Matsumoto castle
activities.description: The black keep they call the crow castle, standing on its moat with the Alps behind it, an original from the sixteenth century.

program.name: Karuizawa
program.description: A highland night at Karuizawa, with the Daruma temple and Stone Church on the way, then the monkeys and Matsumoto castle before Tokyo.

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Five days in the hills north of Tokyo, timed for the maples. Nikko and Karuizawa in autumn are worth the short nights.
expert.tip: Go in the first half of November for the colour at Nikko. The monkeys are there all year, but the maples are not.

summary: Five days in the hills north of Tokyo: a first night in Shinjuku, then Nikko's shrines and gardens, the Daruma temple and Stone Church on the way to Karuizawa, and the Jigokudani monkeys with Matsumoto castle before you fly home.
included: Included: 4 nights with daily breakfast; private transfers and trains throughout; Nikko heritage tour with Rinno-ji, the Shoyoen garden and Toshogu shrine; Shorinzan Daruma temple; the Stone Church at Karuizawa; Jigokudani monkey park; Matsumoto castle entry.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
